messages:
maya: customer reported sudden embeddings throughput dip this morning. tokens/sec steady (~1.2k) but vectors/sec ~50% lower. they also saw intermittent 401s and a few "dimension mismatch" errors in the same window. ticket: #8472

james: on it. can you paste a sample failing payload and the model name? any recent rollout for that model?

maya: model=rdw-embed-large-v2, client batch_size=16, batch_window_ms=50. sample payload attached below — looks like mixed-dimension inputs in single batch from their batching library.

maya: ```
POST /v1/embeddings
Authorization: Bearer sk-prod-XXXX
Content-Type: application/json
{
  "model": "rdw-embed-large-v2",
  "inputs": [
    {"text":"a...","meta":{"dim":256}},
    {"text":"b...","meta":{"dim":768}}
  ]
}
```

li: mixed dims will trigger dim-validation and fallback code path. but that normally returns a validation error, not a throughput halving. checking GPU queue metrics and kernel rollout state.

ops-bot: [metric-snapshot] shard=3 gpu_queue_depth=27 worker_slots=4 avg_tokens_sec=1180 avg_vectors_sec=590 kernel_version=2026.03.09-rc2

li: kernel rollout 2026.03.09-rc2 on shard-3 at 3776543200. I see an increased per-request KVCache miss rate on that kernel which can halve vector throughput while tokens/sec (generation) stays similar.

nina: I also see spikes of 401 and 429 from the same tenant in the window: 401s at 3776543225-3228 then 429s after 3776543230. billing meter returned 429 on some requests which would trigger client retries and tighter batching.

james: so multilayer hypothesis: (1) kernel rollout increased KV miss overhead for this model variant, (2) client-side mixed-dim batches cause extra per-item work, (3) transient auth/billing responses caused retry storms and irregular batching. combined -> vectors/sec drop.

maya: repro steps I ran in staging: ramp 5k requests with 30% mixed-dim, batch_window_ms=50, batch_size=16. after ~200s vectors/sec drops by ~45%, queue_depth climbs to 20+.

maya: staging repro script (short):
```bash
# runs concurrent mixed-dim requests
python stress_mixed_dims.py --model rdw-embed-large-v2 --clients 120 --qps 300 --batch-window 50
```

li: quick checks to run:
- verify kernel version on affected shards (`/infra/shards/shard-3/metadata`)
- query kvcache miss rate: metric `kvcache.miss_rate{model=rdw-embed-large-v2,shard=3}`
- inspect auth logs for that tenant id between 3776543200-3776543300

james: I'm going to temporarily pin the tenant route to rdw-embed-large-v1 (previous kernel) and reduce batch_window_ms to 20ms for their API key to avoid large mixed batches. will also ask infra to roll-back kernel on shard-3 if pin fixes it.

nina: I'll reach out to customer with status and suggest they stop sending mixed-dim batches until we confirm. also asking them to check batching library version (we've seen older libs pack mixed dims).

ops-bot: incident created INC-2026-8472 priority=P2 owner=james start_ts=3776543350

james: actions assigned:
- james: pin route + key override (ETA 15m)
- li: collect kvcache metrics and confirm kernel rollback plan (ETA 30m)
- nina: customer notification + ask for client batching sample (ETA 10m)
- maya: reproduce in staging with updated batch_window and report numbers (ETA 40m)

maya: immediate mitigation note: set per-route `max_batch_window_ms`=25 and `reject_mixed_dims`=true. that should restore vectors/sec and stop dimension mismatch errors while we investigate kernel.

james: good. I'll follow up once pin is live.

li: logged a find: kernel 2026.03.09-rc2 includes an optimization for kernel-launch that regresses for kvcache sizes > 1.2GB on A100-80GB — looks like shard-3 has higher memory footprint. pushing rollback.

nina: customer acked and paused mixed-dim batching. will escalate contract billing note if 429s persist.

maya: closing loop: will attach staging metric dump and the raw failing request IDs to ticket #8472 once repro run completes.

james: thanks team. next update in ~30m or sooner if rollback completes.
